mla_width.diagnostics_note: margin_in / margin_out / runner_up_* / at_cap / at_budget describe the ARGMIN rule's per-layer search, not this fixed width
mla_width.rule: m* = argmin_m D_derot(m) + lam-tail(B-2m), the residual UN-ROPED at the damped read-out (dt_mla_unrope_width.compute_budgets), largest m on a tie, per layer, directions in the arm's rotary-allocation order; w = 2m
mla_width.rounding: median over layers of m*, half up in integers
